title: archkeel.toml configuration (after TOML decoding)
$comment: Filesystem existence, directory/file types, and containment after symlink resolution require runtime validation.

roots.description: Repository-relative source roots, not globs. A dot selects the repository root. Python and Dart roots are directories; TypeScript roots may be files or directories. Runtime validation checks each path.

namespace.description: ASCII dotted package prefix used for internal imports; for Dart, the pubspec name.

contract.description: Repository-relative architecture contract file, independent of scan roots.

tsconfig.description: TypeScript project config. TypeScript defaults to tsconfig.json; runtime validation checks that it exists inside the repository.

collector_argv.description: Optional collector command and arguments as separate tokens; no shell parsing is applied.

relativePath.description: Safe POSIX repository-relative path; no absolute path, colon, glob syntax, NUL, or parent component.
